h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nanded

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nanded

items.pText: Nanded, on the Godavari in Marathwada, is known across the country for the Takht Sachkhand Sri Hazur Sahib gurdwara. The city's schools, housing societies, trusts and municipal gardens are buying more play equipment, and many are working to a fixed budget. A common question from Nanded is how to split that budget between equipment, flooring and shade.

FunPlay Systems is a playground equipment manufacturer based in Vasai, about 460 km from Nanded, so dispatch by road is straightforward. Within Maharashtra we have also installed a playground for Raymond in Thane. Share your site size, the age group of the children and a figure you want to stay within. We will suggest equipment that fits and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Splitting a budget between equipment, flooring and shade

c: Start with the equipment children will use most, then set aside part of the budget for the surface beneath it. A fall onto hard ground is the most common cause of injury, so we would rather you buy one piece fewer and add rubber flooring in the safe play area.
Marathwada summers are hot and dry, so shade comes next. A pergola or gazebo from our
can follow in a second phase. Many buyers begin with a compact multi play system and a few
, then add swings later. You can see one of our Maharashtra installations at

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: We have a fixed budget. Where should we start?
items.a: With the pieces children will use every day and the flooring under them. Shade and extra items can come later. We can show you a first phase and a full plan on the same layout.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment in Nanded?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture in Vasai, dispatch by road to Nanded and install through our own team or a dealer. Nearby towns such as Parbhani and Latur are covered the same way.
We strongly suggest an impact-absorbing surface in the safe play area, especially under slides, swings and climbers. Hard, dry Marathwada ground does not soften a fall.
